hero.description: MoveVN supports evidence reconciliation. Both parties agree and pay directly outside the platform.

compensationDirection.OwnerRefundsCustomer: Owner refunds/reduces payment for the customer

settlementMethod.ExternalOnly: Direct payment between the two parties
settlementMethod.DepositThenExternal: Paid from the wallet, remaining amount paid directly

list.emptyDescription: Cases matching your filters will appear here.

detail.title: Dispute details
detail.reportUnconfirmed: Customer has not confirmed the report
detail.trafficFineResolutionNote: Payment status is tracked in the traffic fine case and document history.
detail.noPlatformCompensation: No compensation is incurred through the platform. The case has been forwarded to the competent authority.
detail.platformSettlementPending: Expected to be paid via wallet
detail.followUpOverdue: Overdue, requires Admin follow-up. Do not self-accept or mark as paid.
detail.finalLateReturnFee: Final late return fee (0đ to waive)
detail.refundExternalPayments: If the fee was confirmed as received directly by the owner, refund the difference from the owner's wallet to the customer's wallet. Refund is only recorded when the wallet has sufficient funds.
detail.correctedReturnAt: Correct the handover time if the report is wrong (optional)
detail.checkoutAdjustmentHint: Applies only when the decision takes effect. New fees replace old ones; amounts already collected above the new level are refunded to the customer's wallet. Do not re-enter this difference as compensation.
detail.settlementFromWallet: Compensation is transferred from the paying party's wallet; the remaining amount is handled externally.
detail.settlementExternalOnly: Both parties pay each other outside the system.
detail.noCompensationHint: No compensation is incurred through the platform.
detail.evidenceRequestPlaceholder: Additional photos, receipts or explanations needed...

settlementConfirm.title: Awaiting settlement confirmation
settlementConfirm.externalFullAmount: The full amount of {{amount}} is settled directly between the two parties outside the system.

create.title: Create a new dispute
create.damageHint: A return report is required and must be submitted within 48 hours of the return.
create.accidentHint: No 48-hour limit. No compensation is incurred through the platform.
create.paymentScopeHint: Security deposits and remaining rental paid directly are not accepted.

confirmCreate.title: Before creating the dispute
confirmCreate.trafficFineDescription: Check the notice, license plate, violation time and document photos. The case is submitted for verification; liability or payment has not been recorded yet.
confirmCreate.generalDescription: Please contact the other party directly to resolve the issue. If you cannot reach an agreement, continue creating the dispute on the system.

trafficFine.title: Traffic fine case
trafficFine.legacyDescription: This case has no notice information and payment documents under the new flow. The old processing status does not prove the fine was paid. A new traffic fine case with complete information is required for tracking.
trafficFine.rentalPeriodConfirmed: Based on actual pickup and return times.
trafficFine.rentalPeriodEstimated: Estimated times/report used; staff must verify handover evidence.
trafficFine.rentalPeriodMatch: The violation time falls within the reviewed period.
trafficFine.rentalPeriodMismatch: The violation time falls outside the reviewed period.
trafficFine.paymentModeReimburse: The customer reimburses exactly what the owner paid for the fine. The owner confirms full receipt, then staff verify the documents.
trafficFine.paymentModeDirect: The customer pays the fine directly to the authority and submits the receipt for staff verification.
trafficFine.trackingNote: MoveVN tracks documents; wallets or booking deposits are never deducted automatically.
trafficFine.rejectionReason: Case rejection reason: {{reason}}. Rejecting the case on MoveVN does not cancel the authority's fine notice.
trafficFine.verify: Verify case and request customer response
trafficFine.acceptanceHint: Accepting liability does not mean payment has been made.
trafficFine.proofImagesLabel: Payment document photos (1–6 photos, max 5 MB each)
trafficFine.confirmReceipt: I confirm I have received the full {{amount}}
trafficFine.reviewHint: Check the receipt, recipient, amount and transaction code. Only confirm after verifying the documents.
trafficFine.approveProof: Approve documents and complete the case
trafficFine.evidenceTargetLabel: Party that must provide additional evidence
trafficFine.escalate: Escalate traffic fine case to admin
trafficFine.toastUpdatedMessage: Status and documents have been saved.
trafficFine.errorProofRequired: Payment date, receipt code and 1–6 JPG/PNG/WebP photos (max 5 MB each) are required.

createTrafficFine.paymentModeCustomer: Customer pays the fine directly to the authority
createTrafficFine.paymentModeReimburse: Customer reimburses the amount the owner already paid
createTrafficFine.ownerPaidAtLabel: Time the owner paid the fine (Vietnam time)
createTrafficFine.receiptLabel: Receipt proving the owner paid the full fine (1–6 photos)
createTrafficFine.noticeHint: You must attach photos of the fine notice in the evidence section below. An unverified case does not establish that the customer violated or already paid.

errors.loadListFailed: Unable to load the dispute list.
errors.loadBookingsFailed: Unable to load completed or returned bookings.
errors.uploadEvidenceIncomplete: Unable to upload all evidence photos.

toast.fineMissingMessage: Enter the notice information, a whole VND amount and upload notice photos. If the owner already advanced the payment, the payment date and receipt are also required.
toast.createdMessage: The case has been sent to staff.
toast.tooManyImagesMessage: You can select at most {{max}} evidence photos.
toast.invalidImageMessage: Only JPG, PNG, WebP are accepted and each photo must be under 5MB.
toast.invalidSurchargeLateReturn: Enter a non-negative whole VND amount; enter 0 to waive the fee.
toast.invalidSurchargeEach: Enter a non-negative whole VND amount for each surcharge.
toast.updatedMessage: The dispute status has been updated.
toast.evidenceRequestedMessage: The request for additional evidence has been sent.
toast.evidenceSubmittedMessage: The evidence has been sent back to staff.
toast.settlementConfirmedMessage: Your direct settlement confirmation has been recorded.
toast.closedMessage: Admin closed the case with a reason.
toast.invalidImagesLimitMessage: At most 6 JPG, PNG, WebP photos; max 5MB each.
